plan.title: Cancel Offered on Saved eRFX Draft

steps.note: Open the existing saved eRFX draft on its create screen.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the tenant.
Verify the draft's three-dot project menu offers an enabled Cancel action.
Select Cancel from the draft project's three-dot menu without confirming the cancellation.
Verify that selecting Cancel opens its confirmation window and leaves the draft unchanged until confirmation.
